item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Justin Sun calls for Trump family-linked WLFI token to be delisted
item.description: Sun also urged exchanges to issue warnings, restrict deposits and require disclosure of where funds had gone.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: ASEAN+3 agrees on initiative to explore crypto payments cooperation
item.description: A working group will examine enhancing connectivity between domestic digital payment networks and bringing their regulations into more alignment.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Binance plans Asia hub in Bhutan, receives preliminary approval
item.description: The agreement is a milestone in Binance’s effort to expand its presence in Bhutan since launching a national crypto-powered tourism payment system in 2025.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Franklin Templeton makes room for HYPE in crypto index ETF
item.description: The addition comes as US spot investment products tracking Hyperliquid’s native token reach $266.5 million in assets under management.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Bitcoin whales pile into BTC despite shrinking profit cushion
item.description: CryptoQuant data shows Bitcoin whales are breaking with historical fourth-quarter selling patterns despite a market downturn.

item.title: China sets March 2027 rollout for blockchain identity regulations
item.description: China has issued new regulations governing blockchain-based digital identities, setting rules for cross-platform verification and data privacy.

item.title: Bitcoin price drops below $59K as Anthropic joins tech stock rebound
item.description: Bitcoin price volatility returned at the Wall Street open as BTC/USD dropped to local lows of $58,700 while stocks and gold headed higher.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: What was Coinbase worth while Nasdaq was closed?
item.description: A Thanksgiving buyer paid 106.24 USDC per Coinbase share. Whether that looked like a holiday rally depended on when you’d last checked the stock.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Binance to launch tokenized IPO program after regulatory approval: Yi He
item.description: Binance is hiring for equity capital markets roles, including an analyst to develop tokenized equity products and assess prospective issuers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Brazil’s stock exchange pushes stablecoin launch back to 2027
item.description: Brazil’s stock exchange is working with six major financial institutions on a real-backed stablecoin that could launch as early as the first quarter of 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Austria-supervised crypto firms report 20.4B euros in H1 trading volume
item.description: About 74% of accounts were based in other EEA countries, highlighting the market’s cross-border nature and putting Europe’s supervisory framework in focus, FMA said.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin supply metric hits 11-year low as new ‘capitulation’ signal arrives
item.description: The seven-day moving average of Bitcoin’s supply profit/loss ratio hit an 11-year low as BTC price losses month-to-date remain near 20%.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bluefin to shut down perps, refocus on spot trading and tokenized RWAs
item.description: Bluefin will close its perps platform on Dec. 4, exiting a shrinking Sui market where it once handled over $500 million in daily trades.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: ESMA to overhaul EU’s MiCA crypto register in 2027
item.description: ESMA’s new MiCA register will replace manual reporting and introduce automated data checks and a version history for crypto white papers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: New York AG secures $1.37B court judgment against NovaTech founders
item.description: The judgment follows an August 2025 default ruling against the founders over a Ponzi scheme that targeted Haitian and other immigrant communities.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Japan’s crypto security group taps SEAL to speed up hack response
item.description: The partnership comes weeks after a third-party data breach exposed hundreds of thousands of customer email addresses belonging to two Japanese crypto exchanges.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Ethereum devs set Glamsterdam’s Hoodi rollout for mid-December after delays
item.description: Glamsterdam’s Hoodi upgrade was delayed in October after concerns that changes to gas pricing could break some existing smart contracts.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: AI is driving a flood of crypto bug reports. Now it’s helping sort them
item.description: Bug bounty platform HackerOne said it’s increasing its triage throughput with AI agents after a record quarter of reports in the third quarter.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
item.description: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash’s privacy design sets it apart.

item.title: ‘Very racist’ Netflix SBF series, BitMart’s $319M shortfall: Asia Express
item.description: Netflix’s The Altruist has been slammed for its ‘very racist’ portrayal of CZ. BitMart reportedly has a $319.5 million shortfall and just $1.9M in liquid assets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: BNB Chain details new layer-1 for trading, private finance and AI
item.description: The proposed network will operate alongside BNB Smart Chain and retain BNB as its native token, with a public testnet targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

item.title: Binance completes withdrawal recovery four weeks after $6.3B hack
item.description: The announcement concludes a phased withdrawal recovery that began on Nov. 1, when Binance restored Bitcoin withdrawals following the record crypto theft.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: UK is ‘getting it wrong’ on DeFi regulation, says Coinbase
item.description: Coinbase and Stand With Crypto argue that the FCA’s proposed DeFi rules could leave UK users without regulated access to decentralized finance.

item.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
item.description: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Spain moves to grant financial watchdog power to freeze crypto accounts
item.description: A new decree would allow Spain’s financial intelligence unit to suspend crypto accounts, with firms facing fines for noncompliance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Crypto on notice as hawkish Fed risks December ‘meltdown’
item.description: Economist Robin Brooks warned of dire consequences for stocks if the Federal Reserve fails to deliver dovish cues before the FOMC blackout period.

item.title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
item.description: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: How EU brokers could lose access to Kyrgyz crypto exchanges
item.description: A vote on Kyrgyzstan could make an exchange’s home country the deciding factor in whether a European broker can use it to settle a trade.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
item.description: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.
